date_text: Thu, May 21st • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, May 24th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Part two of the UK shipment is seriously stacked. We’re pouring an incredible lineup from Vault City and Azvex, showcasing two breweries doing some very exciting things in the UK beer scene right now. Vault City are world-renowned for their huge, flavour-packed sours, and if you know, you know. Expect big fruit, bold flavours, and beers that disappear very quickly once the taps start flowing. Azvex, meanwhile, will be making their Sweeney’s rooftop debut — and they’ve arrived with a massive recommendation behind them. We’re genuinely excited to try these beers for the first time alongside everyone else. These kegs won’t last long, and once they’re gone, they’re gone. Get the crew together, get to the rooftop, and settle in for another huge week of incredible UK beer. 🍻 Tap List:- - Azvex Dockers Umbrella Lager - 4.8% - Azvex Barbarian Robin IPA – 6.2% - Azvex Non-Genuine Ink Cartridges DIPA – 8% - Azvex CRUMBLE - Cinnamon Dusted Apple Crumble Ice Cream Sour – 5% - Azvex Plato's Cave Peanut Butter Cookie Stout – 5.8% - Azvex Strategic Reserve 4 Imperial Stout – 11% - Azvex Cacaodemon III Imperial Stout – 12% - Vault City Gold Standard Ferrero Rocher Imp Stout - 15% - Vault City Iron Brew Sour – 5.5% - Vault City Red Berry Waffle Cone Shortcake Triple Scoop – 8.4% - Vault City/One Drop collab - Summer Down Under Smoothie Sour - 6%
